# Knowledge map: L3 user space: original im.elf under InterpreterProbe

<!-- Generated by `python -m tools.research.knowledge_map build` from `docs/map/sources/l3-userspace.toml`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Scope:** Original Sony user-space processes (interpreter, linker, libc/NPTL, UIPC/OSAL, DMM, timers, GRM, GLES/Sugilite) executed under InterpreterProbe with explicit guest contracts.
- **Evidence span:** see record index; last reviewed 2026-11-26.
- **Deep review:** 22 of 82 records read in full and checked claim by claim ([curation plan](CURATION_PLAN.md)); the rest are curated from titles, lead paragraphs and consolidated documents.
- **Status legend:** PHYSICAL = observed on the camera/host; OFFLINE = disassembly, Unicorn or static proof; INFERENCE = argued from evidence, not observed directly; RETRACTED/REFUTED = do not rely on, kept to prevent re-derivation.

The evidence records are authoritative; follow the links before acting on a claim.

## Frontier

### <a id="f01"></a>F01 - Advance DefRootView past the transparent root view

- **State:** `open`
- **Next:** Qualify the external av-cam.bin / sub-micro UPM (0x920572 / 0x920021) and ObjPower (0x0059000E) producers so CheckerBootState / CheckerBootType can advance, without injecting replies.

## Entities

### <a id="process-im-elf"></a>im.elf (Sony main application process)

`process.im-elf` | process | inventory `firmware.elf:nflasha15_unpacked/bin/im.elf`

Sony's main application process. On the camera it runs as PID 149 with argv 'im.elf debug s g r u l i a lazy-global' and about 181 threads. Executed unmodified under InterpreterProbe.

Aliases: `PID 149`, `im.elf debug s g r u l i a lazy-global`

Current knowledge:

- **C03** `OFFLINE` im.elf's main entry uses the /dev/uipc IPC contract; stdio, UIPC callbacks, sys_clone threads, NPTL multithreading and a cooperative scheduler bring up its infrastructure threads. ([E0017](../evidence/0017-application-entry-and-uipc-contract.md), [E0018](../evidence/0018-standard-io-and-uipc-callbacks.md), [E0019](../evidence/0019-multithreading-and-sys-clone.md), [E0027](../evidence/0027-original-clone-return-and-phase-survey.md))
- **C08** `PHYSICAL` On the camera im.elf is PID 149 with argv 'im.elf debug s g r u l i a lazy-global'; clone-derived GLES identity and /dev/stream2 follow from the observed startup. ([E0301](../evidence/0301-uipc-lifecycle-camera-argv-and-checkpoint-retry.md), [E0302](../evidence/0302-gles-identity-stream2-and-memory-boundary.md))
- **C09** `OFFLINE` With a modelled positive UIPC receive timeout the app leaves a 19M-instruction poll loop for a real wait and, at 308.6M instructions, is service-idle waiting for producers. ([E0308](../evidence/0308-uipc-timeout-blocking-and-real-wait.md), [E0309](../evidence/0309-blocked-uipc-dependency-map.md))
- **C11** `OFFLINE` Every former heap assertion was caused by Unicorn 2.1.4 carrying stale Thumb-2 ITSTATE across IT-block branches; with the fix, unmodified im.elf runs 1.50B instructions and 120 threads with 0 heap ownership errors and no 0x4C->0x50 padding. ([E0657](../evidence/0657-unicorn-l3-allocator-gles-init-and-sugilite-gpu.md))
- **C16** `OFFLINE` Platform and loader facts were extracted from the firmware: 474 ARM ELF files parse without errors; original process startup lacks filesystem metadata until guarded inode metadata and the original module request are modelled. ([E0001](../evidence/0001-platform-and-loader.md), [E0002](../evidence/0002-original-process-startup.md), [E0028](../evidence/0028-readonly-inode-metadata-and-module-request.md))
- **C18** `OFFLINE` Package H reaches the stack-guard entropy boundary; original urandom dispatch and a guarded entropy read pass it; the OpenSSL SIGILL capability probe meets a /tmp boundary. ([E0023](../evidence/0023-package-h-entropy-boundary.md), [E0024](../evidence/0024-urandom-dispatch-and-read-boundary.md), [E0033](../evidence/0033-sigill-capability-probe-and-tmp-boundary.md))
- **C23** `OFFLINE` An authentic standby LCD and a 125M fast-hooks milestone came with the THREAD_INFRA0 synchronous dispatch architecture; the authentic UIPC OSAL header and MonDrv WBI log buffer reach 143.74M instructions; /proc/modules, FBResourceManager and the MediaDetect polling boundary follow, and the THREAD_INFRA1 poll is MonDrv output-queue back-pressure. ([E0083](../evidence/0083-authentic-standby-lcd-and-infra0-worker-pipeline.md), [E0095](../evidence/0095-uipc-osal-header-mondrv-log-and-143m-milestone.md), [E0096](../evidence/0096-proc-modules-fbresourcemanager-and-mediadetect-poll.md), [E0097](../evidence/0097-mediadetect-poll-is-mondrv-output-backpressure.md))
- **C25** `PHYSICAL` Read-only dumps of the MPR partition (erased-state ioctl identity), nflasha1 vfat (observed /mnt mount/umount, updater-state read) and the nflasha2 /setting namespace carry the replay past /dev/nflasha4 to the app's idle/poll state. ([E0305](../evidence/0305-mpr-readonly-dump-and-erased-state-ioctl.md), [E0306](../evidence/0306-nflasha1-vfat-mount-and-updater-state.md), [E0307](../evidence/0307-nflasha2-setting-namespace-uipc-unregister-and-idle-state.md))
- **C32** `OFFLINE` The proposed combined namespace has 1,439 paths and 120 symlinks, including /lib/ld-linux.so.3 -> ld-2.11.2.so and /lib/libc.so.6 -> libc-2.11.2.so; all 14 static candidate objects for im.elf, its interpreter and its DT_NEEDED closure resolve with no missing name under the declared search paths. ([E0002](../evidence/0002-original-process-startup.md)) *Note: The /lib and /usr/lib search paths are explicit assumptions, not a recovered loader search order; nflasha7 is provisionally / and nflasha15 /usr.*
- **C35** `OFFLINE` init contains 22 mount records: the mnts table is at 0x13308 (440 bytes, 20-byte records) and the helper at 0x8eac calls mount at 0x8ece. The /usr sequence tries /dev/dnflasha15 ext2, /dev/nflasha15 ext2, then nflasha15 cramfs and vfat; main mounts /dev/nflasha10 at /etc (vfat, flags 0xc0ed0490, data posix_attr). ([E0008](../evidence/0008-runtime-mount-boundaries.md))
- **C37** `OFFLINE` The static UI-host chain is init -> bootin.elf -> im.elf: init main loads /usr/bin/bootin.elf at 0x9b54 and calls run_bg_process at 0x9b56; bootin builds 'im.elf s &' and 'im.elf g &' commands at 0x9910/0x991a and calls system at 0x991c; im.elf's routine at 0xb200 selects /usr/lib/libObj.so at 0xb20e-0xb216, calls dlopen at 0xb21c, dlsym at 0xb240 and the resolved function at 0xb254. ([E0002](../evidence/0002-original-process-startup.md)) *Note: The branches are conditional; which entry and boot mode select this chain is still open, and the record does not prove complete UI startup.*
- **C39** `OFFLINE` 474 ARM ELF files parse without errors: 85 executables, 276 shared objects and 113 relocatable objects. im.elf and WS_SubProcess.elf specify interpreter //lib/ld-linux.so.3, and mount.conf declares nflasha3 at /system, nflasha7 at /rootfs and nflasha15 at /usr; these are static declarations, not runtime mounts. ([E0001](../evidence/0001-platform-and-loader.md))
- **C45** `OFFLINE` After relocating all 12 libraries the linker protects its own RELRO with mprotect(0x4001f000, 0x1000, PROT_READ) at 1,997,182 instructions, then services set_tid_address 256, set_robust_list 338 (12-byte head), rt_sigaction 174 and rt_sigprocmask 175 (sigsetsize 8) and ugetrlimit 191 (RLIMIT_STACK 8 MiB) before the shared-library constructors run. ([E0016](../evidence/0016-kuser-helpers-and-shared-library-init.md))
- **C48** `OFFLINE` ld-2.11.2.so transfers control to im.elf at 0x9140 (Thumb 0x9141) at 2,073,233 instructions; the application allocates a 52-byte message, registers Task 94 to system queue 0x8f013a, exchanges messages with queues 0x3e014d and 0x94016a, and stops at fstat64(fd 1) at 2,107,153 with inherited_stdio_not_supplied. ([E0017](../evidence/0017-application-entry-and-uipc-contract.md))
- **C49** `OFFLINE` Inherited stdio is backed by nflasha7 /dev/console metadata (inode 118, mode 8576 = S_IFCHR|0600, rdev 0x501, uid 0, gid 5); TCGETS (0x5401) returns -ENOTTY (-25) so libc uses block buffering, and write 4 / writev 146 outputs are captured in diagnostic logs without host leakage. ([E0018](../evidence/0018-standard-io-and-uipc-callbacks.md))
- **C50** `OFFLINE` The app registers asynchronous callbacks for queue 0x94016a (0x9635), queue 0 (0x50031d35) and queue 0x940270 (0x95f7) via 0x80000008, sends a direct synchronous 16-byte-header packet to queue 0x920277 via 0x80000006, runs Task 94 phases 0-4 to queue 0x8f013a, and reaches clone (r0=0x3d0f00) at 2,218,147 instructions. ([E0018](../evidence/0018-standard-io-and-uipc-callbacks.md))
- **C51** `OFFLINE` The NPTL clone contract validates flags 0x3d0f00, reads the child entry and argument from [child_stack, #0..8], sets R0=arg, SP=child_stack+8, PC=fn&~1 and LR=0x502a0628, writes TIDs 1001-1003 to parent_tidptr and returns the child TID; gettid is 224, prctl 172 (PR_SET_NAME 15), sched_setscheduler 156. ([E0019](../evidence/0019-multithreading-and-sys-clone.md))
- **C52** `OFFLINE` Linux ARM numbers sched_setaffinity as 241 and sched_getaffinity as 242; E0019's '242 = sched_setaffinity' label is corrected here (E0314). ([E0019](../evidence/0019-multithreading-and-sys-clone.md), [E0314](../evidence/0314-gpes-bar-irq-contract-engine-model.md))
- **C53** `OFFLINE` osal_create_waitable_thread locks a stack mutex before clone and blocks in pthread_mutex_lock; FUTEX_WAIT_PRIVATE parks the parent and switches to the child, and FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE releases it. THREAD_INFRA0 (TID 1001, entry 0x954d, priority 4) executes 18,322 instructions; the main thread reaches 2,367,687 instructions and waits on semaphore 0x83037a (ioctl 0x80000001, timeout 0xffffffff). ([E0019](../evidence/0019-multithreading-and-sys-clone.md)) *Note: E0026 shows the cooperative restore did not update hardware TPIDRURO; this run is an observation of the pre-fix implementation, and C68 scopes the threaded results.*
- **C54** `OFFLINE` The UIPC binary semaphore commands are STAT 0x80000000, WAI 0x80000001 and SIG 0x80000002; semaphore 0x83037a is initially available and is acquired without blocking. The app spawns a fourth thread (TID 1004), sends to Task 92 queue 0x00920021 (SND_MSG 0x80000004), queries depth (0x80000003) and receives with 0x80000007, where empty returns -EAGAIN and OSAL reports 0xfffffc00; nanosleep 162 with {1,0} drives the 1 Hz loop for 8,777,210+ instructions and 17,000+ cycles. ([E0020](../evidence/0020-uipc-semaphores-and-event-loop.md))
- **C55** `OFFLINE` Task 94's callback 0x9a5c reads event_id = [msg_ptr] and dispatches 0x00940031-0x00940037 to phase handlers (0xb694) and 0x00920152 to a boot notification that queries 0x00920111 to 0x00924127, sets boot mode at 0x14ed4 and starts plugin initialization at 0xae8c. libIMDB's .data.rel.ro holds 198 records of 44 bytes naming kmods, daemons and the Phase-1 libraries libDpro_EVF.so, libBizInitializer.so, appFw.so and gui.so. ([E0021](../evidence/0021-event-dispatch-and-display-subsystem.md), [E0022](../evidence/0022-task94-boot-events-and-plugin-subsystems.md))
- **C57** `OFFLINE` Delivering 0x00940007, 0x0092014b, 0x00940036 and 0x00940038 into queue 0x0094016a reaches 15,000,000 instructions and 592 serviced syscalls while loading more than 30 Sony libraries through the original linker (do_lookup_x at 0x40007048). E0023 corrects the E0022 open count: only 44 of the 86 opens succeeded, the rest were failed searches encoded as unsigned errno, and successful opens are not completed plugin initialization. ([E0022](../evidence/0022-task94-boot-events-and-plugin-subsystems.md), [E0023](../evidence/0023-package-h-entropy-boundary.md))
- **C60** `OFFLINE` Package H stops at 41,953,485 instructions during open of /dev/urandom (runtime_namespace_not_supplied, syscall 5, PC 0x5008bc64). libssp's initializer at 0x9c4 checks __stack_chk_guard, loads /dev/urandom at 0x9d4/0x9d6, calls open at 0x9d8 and read at 0x9e8. A 100,000,000-instruction run timed out at 18,291,523 instructions, and a timeout is not success; the longer run serviced 600 syscalls. ([E0023](../evidence/0023-package-h-entropy-boundary.md))
- **C62** `OFFLINE` The bounded bootin handler shows events 0x940031-0x940037 selecting separate im.elf launches s, g, r, u, l, i and a; 0x940038 returns 0xfffffc06. Incoming 0x940002 selects destination 0x94020a with outgoing 0x940001, and 0x9400f3/0x9400f4 select 0x94016a; the helper builds a 16-byte body with a four-byte prefix, for example [0x94020a, 0x9400f3, 0, 0, 0]. ([E0025](../evidence/0025-boot-producers-and-argument-selected-startup.md))
- **C63** `OFFLINE` im.elf i with no injected messages reaches 41,782,766 instructions with 473 responses and zero entropy bytes, while im.elf a (flags 0x400003) produces 094_a_thread markers and only 13 successful opens with no plugin file opens. The futex mismatch path was corrected from -EINVAL (0xffffffea) to -EAGAIN (0xfffffff5); the a run's stack-context retry loop remained open at this record. ([E0025](../evidence/0025-boot-producers-and-argument-selected-startup.md))
- **C64** `OFFLINE` E0026 finds the thread-context defect: restore_context updated the software TLS slot but not hardware TPIDRURO, while original libpthread at 0xab90 executes 'mrc p15, 0, r4, c13, c0, 3; sub.w r4, r4, #0x4c0'. After restoring both, the a run stops at 2,298,610 instructions on madvise(0x50480000, 0x7fa000, MADV_DONTNEED); the opt-in advice-4 contract zeroes only known private anonymous pages, and the five-million run then services 21,259 responses in the event loop. dlopen("gui.so") returns 0 and //lib/gui.so, //usr/lib/gui.so and libVssApp.so are ENOENT in the snapshot. ([E0026](../evidence/0026-thread-tls-and-stack-discard.md))
- **C65** `OFFLINE` Clone now resumes the child at the original syscall-return PC 0xa05d8 with r0=0 instead of a host-chosen pthread entry; only flags 0x3d0f00 are accepted. im.elf i reaches 41,782,801 instructions with 473 responses and the same entropy stop, and im.elf l reaches 2,222,528 instructions with 196 responses on an unverified st_rdev read after opening /usr/kmod/liro.ko; no module is inserted and framebuffer transactions remain zero. ([E0027](../evidence/0027-original-clone-return-and-phase-survey.md))
- **C66** `OFFLINE` With --regular-inode-rdev and --readonly-image-times, im.elf l reaches syscall 128 (init_module) at 2,226,764 instructions and 197 responses, requesting 65,276 bytes whose buffer hash is 72cb5700d34ecac6f8a9475f05268e55c94bf972183884bdb0e6d95edc40d9f7, matching /usr/kmod/liro.ko, with parameter string ' adr=0x0 '. The request is not serviced; liro.ko declares dependencies osal_uipc, backup, osal_utm and dma330 and vermagic 3.0.27_nl-rt106+ SMP preempt mod_unload ARMv7. ([E0028](../evidence/0028-readonly-inode-metadata-and-module-request.md)) *Note: E0029 later identifies unverified backup-service acknowledgements before this request; the default runner stops at the earlier reply, and this run remains reproducible only under the explicit historical --backup-service unverified-ack option.*
- **C68** `OFFLINE` E0026 retroactively scopes the threaded results: E0019-E0025 switch contexts without updating hardware TPIDRURO, so their thread observations (including the E0019 infrastructure-thread runs and the E0025 argv results) describe the recorded cooperative implementation, not corrected-TLS NPTL behavior. E0027's clone-return model supersedes E0026's direct-function clone shortcut. ([E0019](../evidence/0019-multithreading-and-sys-clone.md), [E0025](../evidence/0025-boot-producers-and-argument-selected-startup.md), [E0026](../evidence/0026-thread-tls-and-stack-discard.md), [E0027](../evidence/0027-original-clone-return-and-phase-survey.md))

### <a id="tool-interpreter-probe"></a>InterpreterProbe (L3 user-space executor)

`tool.interpreter-probe` | tool

Bounded Unicorn user-space executor with explicit, opt-in guest contracts (syscalls, devices, mounts). Stops with PC, arguments and reason at anything unsupported.

Current knowledge:

- **C01** `OFFLINE` The original interpreter executes to its first syscall; guarded brk, image-backed kernel identity and a read-only guest filesystem carry it into original library search and header reads. ([E0003](../evidence/0003-original-interpreter-boundary.md), [E0004](../evidence/0004-guest-brk-contract.md), [E0005](../evidence/0005-guarded-kernel-identity.md), [E0006](../evidence/0006-read-only-guest-filesystem.md), [E0007](../evidence/0007-guarded-inode-metadata.md))
- **C20** `OFFLINE` A bounded dependency planner and reusable REA evidence support call-chain work; REA deep analysis is unavailable for the ARM libObj on this host, and the 20 ms constant has six libObj sites. ([E0039](../evidence/0039-dependency-planner-and-evidence-cache.md), [E9005](../evidence/9005-rea-provider-limit-and-20ms-sites.md))
- **C28** `OFFLINE` The original ld-2.11.2.so entered at 0x40000791 with im.elf mapped at its linked addresses executes 1,183 instructions and stops at Thumb svc #0 (00 df) at 0x40010b14 with r7=45 (brk) and r0=0; two fresh runs produced identical complete reports. ([E0003](../evidence/0003-original-interpreter-boundary.md))
- **C29** `OFFLINE` With the brk policy the interpreter executes 2,222 instructions, services brk(0) with the initial break 0x15000 (the page-rounded end of the greatest application PT_LOAD) and stops at syscall 122 (uname) at 0x40010f78. The 64 MiB growth ceiling is an experiment policy, not a recovered camera RLIMIT_DATA. ([E0004](../evidence/0004-guest-brk-contract.md))
- **C30** `OFFLINE` With brk-uname the interpreter reaches 3,091 instructions and stops at access(/etc/ld.so.preload, mode 4). The UTS record at vmlinux.bin offset 0x3c5a90 supplies sysname Linux, release 3.0.27_nl-rt106+ and version '#1 SMP PREEMPT RT Mon May 27 14:09:40 JST 2019'; nodename, machine and domainname stay guarded, and the observed path read only the release field. ([E0005](../evidence/0005-guarded-kernel-identity.md)) *Note: The vmlinux build date differs from the live camera's kernel banner (E0073); they are different builds and neither is claimed to replace the other.*
- **C31** `OFFLINE` The files policy executes 5,078 instructions: the linker checks /etc/ld.so.preload, attempts /etc/ld.so.cache and searches ARM/TLS library directories, receives guest ENOENT for absent paths in the complete static namespace, and stops at stat64 of the existing /lib directory with stat64_success_structure_not_implemented (exit 2). ([E0006](../evidence/0006-read-only-guest-filesystem.md))
- **C36** `OFFLINE` With --respect-runtime-mounts the interpreter stops after 3,091 instructions at the first /etc access with unsupported_filesystem / runtime_namespace_not_supplied instead of returning ENOENT; the snapshot metadata experiment still reproduces its 6,493-instruction boundary. ([E0008](../evidence/0008-runtime-mount-boundaries.md))
- **C40** `OFFLINE` A loader defect discarded the implicit REL addend for R_ARM_ABS32 and R_ARM_GLOB_DAT; the inventory counts 22,286 ABS32 entries in libObj.so and 69,983 in viewUnified2.so. The bounded loader now preserves addends and Thumb state, wraps to ARM32, maps the page-aligned PT_LOAD span and rolls back after a failed load. ([E0001](../evidence/0001-platform-and-loader.md))
- **C41** `OFFLINE` Verified st_dev values 0x0000fc07 for /lib (partition 7) and 0x0000fc0f for /usr (partition 15) satisfy the linker's (st_dev, st_ino) deduplication check and activate the dynamic segment loader at 6,710 instructions; mmap2 is syscall 192, mprotect 125, munmap 91 and close 6, with allocations confined to 0x50000000-0x70000000. ([E0015](../evidence/0015-guarded-mmap2-and-library-load.md))
- **C61** `OFFLINE` With --urandom-open the guest reaches read(4, 0x546a9188, 4) at 41,955,226 instructions and stops with entropy_state_not_supplied (PC 0x5008b1c4, syscall 3); 601 responses include the open and exactly zero entropy bytes are supplied. /dev/urandom is character 1:9 (inode 110 at 0xa280, mode 020444), and the kernel memory-device table at 0x2d6bf0 resolves mem/null/port/zero/full/random/urandom/kmsg with minor 9 using fops 0x603df048, read 0x60296f20 and no open callback. ([E0024](../evidence/0024-urandom-dispatch-and-read-boundary.md))
